name: Update a meeting note already visible in the panel
query: Add the latest launch context to this meeting agenda.

context.conversation: The launch review note is open beside the chat. Its initial agenda was saved and the panel confirmed opening in the previous turn.

sources.https://notion.so/note-123: Launch review, 30 minutes. Existing agenda: rollout decision and support readiness. User note: Keep five minutes for support questions.
sources.https://notion.so/launch: Current rollout: 10%. Rehearsal is still open, owned by Maya. No expansion decision.

success_criteria: Updates note-123 with supported rollout and rehearsal context, preserving the existing agenda and user support note.
Makes zero panel calls because the same note is already visible, including after the final update.
Creates no duplicate note and does not ask the user to reopen the panel.
Does not claim expansion was approved or invent commitments.
